description:
Stdio MCP (Model Context Protocol) bridge for Apache Axis2. Fetches the
        /openapi-mcp.json tool catalog from a running Axis2 deployment and exposes
        those operations as MCP tools to compatible MCP clients.
        Runs as a subprocess launched by an MCP client; communicates via
        newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 on stdin/stdout.
